subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should Sessions ordering use a read-time bounded meaningful-activity projection, stored activity timestamp fields with rollups, or keep `updatedAt` ordering for now?
rationale: The user-visible gap is clear, but the permanent choice affects Gateway RPC shape, row write load, parent/child rollup semantics, and which event classes count as meaningful activity.

options.title: Read-Time Projection
options.body: Derive the sort key and visible reason from bounded recent event/transcript metadata so noisy background work does not rewrite parent rows just to decide ordering.

options.title: Persist Activity Fields
options.body: Add stored `lastEventAt`, `lastMeaningfulActivityAt`, and `lastVisibleConversationAt` fields with tested updates, rollups, and migration or doctor handling.

options.title: Defer Model Change
options.body: Keep `updatedAt` ordering until maintainers approve a broader session activity model and accept the current UX friction in the meantime.

recommendation.title: Read-Time Projection
recommendation.body: Derive the sort key and visible reason from bounded recent event/transcript metadata so noisy background work does not rewrite parent rows just to decide ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Control UI Sessions history and can route the product/storage choice across UI and Gateway session-list surfaces.
